issues.title: PVOS-501 — Golden Dataset Expansion 2.0
issues.body:
## Source
PPP-PVOS-1.2-FEATURE-EXPANSION-2026-08-07 — APPROVED — 2026-08-07 — Approved by Owner

## Queue Identity
- Issue ID: PVOS-501
- Queue Status: READY
- Order: 1

## Capability
- QUA-002

## Objective
Expand the PVOS Golden Dataset and regression foundation using representative scenarios without adding Product behavior.

## Dependencies
- None

## Scope
- Admit sanitized real-world representative scenarios through PM review
- Cover multiple roof geometry cases and partition variations within existing Product authority
- Cover bounded layout-constraint scenarios already supported by the C# Mainline
- Preserve accepted placement, valid no-fit, and rejected-input outcomes
- Expand C# regression evidence, repeatability, comparison rules, and asset integrity

## Out of Scope
- New Product behavior, Product Scope, Product Blueprint, EOS, or Governance changes
- Automatic roof interpretation, shading, Electrical, Construction, UI, Cloud, or PVOS 2.x
- Legacy Asset promotion or direct customer/confidential data admission

## Deliverables
- Golden Dataset Expansion 2.0 Package

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every admitted scenario has provenance, Product authority, one bounded claim, explicit non-claims, and PM admission
- Every Golden asset has an immutable commit, comparison rules, and matching SHA-256
- Expanded regressions validate existing C# Product behavior without introducing behavior

## Required Evidence
- Existing asset inspection and Golden 2.0 scenario registry
- Golden asset integrity record and C# regression report
- Changed-file and excluded-scope audit

## Execution Control
This GitHub Issue is the sole Execution Source for Codex. Stop at `READY_FOR_PM_REVIEW`; PM owns review and closing.

## Objective

- Placement, geometry, capacity, warning, error, or Product result calculation in Python
- A second PVOS Engine, Runtime, Product adapter, or replacement for C# Mainline
- Product Scope, Blueprint, EOS, Governance, PVOS 1.1 status, or PVOS 2.x changes

- Python Validation Tool v0.1 Evidence Package

## Acceptance Criteria
- Manifest validation and evidence reports are deterministic and traceable
- Repeatability and negative checks preserve explicit PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED outcomes
- Source and changed-file inspection prove Python performs no Product calculations and does not replace C# Mainline

## Required Evidence
- Existing Prototype inspection and versioned tool identity
- Unit, integration, negative, and repeatability results
- C# Mainline non-replacement and scope-boundary proof

issues.title: PVOS-504 — Canonical Project Model Review 2
issues.body:
## Source
PPP-PVOS-1.2-FEATURE-EXPANSION-2026-08-07 — APPROVED — 2026-08-07 — Approved by Owner

## Queue Identity
- Issue ID: PVOS-504
- Queue Status: READY
- Order: 4

## Capability
- QUA-003

## Objective
Reassess Canonical Project Model Promotion eligibility using factual evidence while preserving the current no-promotion boundary.

## Dependencies
- PVOS-503 — #85

## Scope
- Review candidate schema and field semantics
- Review ownership and separation from Runtime, adapters, presentation, and Legacy evidence
- Review compatibility and versioning requirements
- Review migration evidence from current typed request and result contracts
- Record exactly one allowed eligibility disposition

## Out of Scope
- Canonical Project Model or Legacy Asset Promotion
- Product Contract, Product Scope, Product Blueprint, or C# domain model modification
- Implementation commitment, PVOS 2.x, EOS, or Governance changes

## Deliverables
- Canonical Project Model Review 2 Recommendation

## Acceptance Criteria
- Schema, ownership, compatibility, migration, Product need, acceptance, and authority each have evidence or an explicit gap
- Disposition is NOT_ELIGIBLE, MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, or ELIGIBLE_FOR_SEPARATE_BASELINE_PROPOSAL
- No disposition directly promotes an asset or modifies the Product Contract

## Required Evidence
- Current and historical evidence inventory
- Condition-by-condition eligibility matrix
- Disposition, gaps, zero-promotion proof, and changed-file audit
